$comment: The Vue port's waves (plan docs/research/code-languages-plan-2026-10-03.md §1 and §3.C): per wave, each React component folder and the public components it exports. W1 is the 23 stateless folders. tools/code-languages/vue-parity.mjs reports each wave's progress. A component that renders a later wave's component waits for it (`waits`: the component and what it waits for); it is not counted in its wave until then.

waits.MetricCard: Card (wave 2): a MetricCard is a Card around a Metric
waits.ToggleListItem: Toggle (wave 2): its control is a ToggleButton
